package loopcheck

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type Handlers struct{}

func checkedFigure(ctx context.Context, row string) (int, error) {
	if err := auth.Require(ctx); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return len(row), nil
}

func uncheckedFigure(row string) int { return len(row) }

// Each loop runs over the figure-free catalog, as a document's cells are read
// after the document is validated.

// Every pass reads its figure through a check.
func (h Handlers) GetEachRowChecked(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out []int
	for _, row := range auth.Catalog() {
		figure, err := checkedFigure(r.Context(), row)
		if err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		out = append(out, figure)
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

// One way through a pass skips the check.
func (h Handlers) GetEachRowSkippingOnePass(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out []int
	for _, row := range auth.Catalog() {
		if row == "won" {
			out = append(out, uncheckedFigure(row))
			continue
		}
		figure, err := checkedFigure(r.Context(), row)
		if err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		out = append(out, figure)
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

// A figure held from before the loop is not covered by checks inside it.
func (h Handlers) GetAfterAnUncheckedFigure(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	names := auth.Catalog()
	out := []int{uncheckedFigure(names[0])}
	for _, row := range names {
		figure, err := checkedFigure(r.Context(), row)
		if err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		out = append(out, figure)
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

// No row, so the loop runs no time and nothing holds a figure.
func (h Handlers) GetNoRows(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out []int
	for _, row := range auth.Catalog()[:0] {
		figure, err := checkedFigure(r.Context(), row)
		if err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		out = append(out, figure)
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}
